body: Video-note expand grew downward into the composer then a 150ms bottom-drift re-pin jumped it. Expand/collapse now adds the height delta to contentOffset in the same spring (0.44s, damping 0.78) so the note stays above the input and older rows move up. Expanded side 248→320. Skip verifyBottomIntegrity while the morph is in flight.
